purpose: Resolve the PEP-HRM-010 transport mismatch and the exact OrganizationExplorer reuse seam before any HRM-005 implementation token is issued, without editing the historical G2 schema or mounting the central HCM route.

preservedFacts: The query fields remain exactly asOf, rootPublicId, depth, relationshipType and includePositions, all required.
The canonical browser path remains GET /api/people/v1/hris/organizations/graph and the owner path remains GET /v1/hris/organizations/graph.
Depth remains bounded to 0 through 12 and every returned organization remains population-authorized.
The historical response contains organization nodes but no position collection, so includePositions cannot be implemented from that response shape without an append-only successor.

provenReuse: OrganizationChartService already resolves an effective-dated tenant-scoped organization subtree and clamps ordinary engine depth to 1 through 12.
OrganizationChartRepository already sources the primary SUPERVISORY organization parent and effective SUPERVISORY position parent at a LocalDate.
OrganizationChartDtos.Position already provides the only position field model admitted by this successor.
The successor is a deterministic read adapter and response projection over the existing engine, not a second graph source or persistence model.

asOf.rule: The same instant always selects the same UTC effective date; JVM, tenant, browser and daylight-saving zones cannot change the selected date. Offset-free local date-time and date-only values fail closed before owner repository access.

rootPublicId.rule: Omission, blank and null are invalid. An absent or unauthorized root is returned through the existing opaque not-found/denial policy without disclosing node existence.

mapping.0: Invoke the existing engine with depth 1 and project only the requested root organization. If includePositions is true, retain only positions owned by that root organization.
mapping.1_TO_12: Pass the exact value to the existing engine. Root is logical depth 0 and descendants through the requested depth are retained.

depth.rule: Values outside 0 through 12 are rejected; they are never clamped by the public successor adapter.

relationshipType.rule: LEGAL and COST return the safe 422 code UNSUPPORTED_RELATIONSHIP_MODEL before repository access. Unknown values return 400. REPORTING cannot be broadened to MATRIX, FUNCTIONAL, administrative parent, legal-entity containment or cost-center membership.
relationshipType.futureRule: LEGAL and COST require separate source-backed graph models, separate authorization and a new append-only successor.

semantics.false: Return positionsIncluded=false and an empty positions array. No position identifier, count, vacancy, incumbent or cost fact may be inferred from the response.
semantics.true: Return positionsIncluded=true and only effective positions whose organizationPublicId belongs to the authorized returned organization set. Depth 0 therefore returns only positions owned by the root organization.

includePositions.authorizationRule: includePositions=true requires the server-authoritative position/employment field decision in addition to the organization population decision; absence of that decision fails closed rather than silently presenting an unauthorized position set.

fields.parentPublicId: nullable UUID mapped from parentOrganizationId; forced null for the response root
fields.name: nonblank string mapped from name
fields.depth: integer 0 through requested depth, recomputed relative to root

fields.title: nonblank string mapped from title
fields.organizationPublicId: UUID mapped from organizationId and required to belong to returned nodes
fields.reportsToPositionPublicId: nullable UUID mapped from reportsToPositionId; null when the effective parent is outside the returned position set
fields.status: string mapped from effective status, including FILLED, OPEN or PLANNED
fields.availabilityDate: nullable ISO local date mapped from availabilityDate
fields.incumbentPersonPublicIds: array of UUID mapped from incumbentPersonIds and sorted lexicographically
fields.subordinatePositionCount: nonnegative integer recomputed after response filtering

stableOrder.nodes: depth ascending, then organizationPublicId canonical string ascending
stableOrder.positions: organizationPublicId canonical string ascending, then positionKey ascending using Unicode code-point order, then positionPublicId canonical string ascending
stableOrder.rule: Database row order, HashMap iteration order and scenario append order are never response ordering authority.

failClosedErrors.condition: missing trusted organization or position authority
root absent from the authorized effective graph

branchingRule.default: When the adapter is absent, execute the existing directory/workforce management OrganizationExplorer branch with behavior, query keys, scenario, intelligence, candidates, commands, URL semantics and rendering equivalent to the pinned source.
branchingRule.canonicalHris: When the exact adapter is present, execute a separate read-only organization/position branch in the same file. Only the canonical graph query may run. Organization and position focus, asOf, root, depth, includePositions and inspector state may be represented in the URL.
branchingRule.hookIsolation: Management hooks and canonical hooks must reside in separate child components so React hook order stays static and the canonical branch never instantiates management mutations.

explorerReuseSeam.managementRegressionRule: The no-adapter branch must retain the existing management behavior. Targeted tests must prove the same requests and enabled states for directory and workforce modes; this successor grants no semantic change to that branch.

peoplePepRuntimePrerequisite.finding: Authorization v49 and its generated People projection contain the organization graph route, but the active HcmV3PepRegistry remains pinned to hcm-people-pep-v42.generated.json and HcmScopeSelectionValidator does not recognize predicate.hcm-organization-graph-authority.v1.
separateCentralPatchAcceptanceRequired: Bind the active People PEP registry to the accepted generated v49 projection and its exact checksum without editing the generated projection.

Add a closed owner implementation for predicate.hcm-organization-graph-authority.v1 that requires the trusted operations TARGET_POPULATION and the exact organization root population before repository access.
Prove the exact GET /v1/hris/organizations/graph binding is owned and accepted only for route.hcm.operations.organization-graph.data with the v49 read-only profile.
Prove wrong route, method, purpose, scope, policy revision, field decision and forged client authority fail before controller or repository access.
Record an independent central patch acceptance receipt and merge it to backend dwp-dev before issuing the HRM-005 token.

migrationDecision.reason: The successor reuses the existing effective-dated organization, relationship, position and People outbox schema. The adapter and response projection introduce no persistence requirement.
migrationDecision.forbidden: Do not create V57, reserve V57 or claim migration credit for HRM-005.

targetedAcceptanceForFutureToken: Strict query validation including UTC conversion around date boundaries and offset-equivalent instants
Depth 0 root-only and depth 1 through 12 exact subtree behavior without public clamping
REPORTING to primary SUPERVISORY mapping and pre-repository LEGAL/COST rejection
includePositions false empty projection and true authorized filtered position projection
Stable node, position and incumbent ordering under shuffled repository inputs
Opaque wrong-tenant, wrong-population, wrong-field and missing-root denial
Canonical adapter no scenario, intelligence, candidate, mutation or export invocation
Changed-path proof excluding central mount paths and historical G2 sources
